constraints: Never issue player combat commands against the production run for benchmarking.
Private snapshot and entropy remain in the ACL-protected local capture directory and runner directories, never in Git or public logs.
Preserve pinned artifacts, historical receipts, exact RNG stream, atomic costs, pending decisions and canonical DTO/renderers.
Local verification before commit/push/deploy; deployment explicitly authorized after local verification.
Do not enable frozen-catalog or preparation-cache experiments to claim an unmeasured performance improvement.

completed.change: Load the party leader through the single ordered party query; retain solo owner projection and row-lock behavior.
completed.acceptance: Owned run loading tested for solo/party and locked/unlocked modes, foreign owner rejected; measured SQL count 19 to 16.

completed.change: Compare inline cold columns even when DB_FROZEN_CATALOGS=0 and omit only unchanged values from UPDATE.
completed.acceptance: Changed shop/checkpoint/catalog values retained, referenced-catalog integrity preserved, 761322 cold bytes omitted in measured fixture.

measurements.productionEndTurnCaveat: One separate process with cold JIT; not a phase trace of the original POST.

steps: Introduce a narrowly scoped worker SHA-256 provider using node:crypto; retain exact existing canonicalStringify bytes and browser fallback.
Test against browser SHA on empty/Unicode/astral/control characters, long strings, numeric edge cases, nested objects, two independent battle scenes and all captured journal states.

Build a new owned worker artifact and replay the same sequence under both executors; compare every random value, state, rejection and hash while accounting only for the explicit artifact version boundary.
Benchmark revision 28 end_turn and short intents with at least 30 first/warm repetitions, recording execute/hash/AI spans.
Release the new artifact normally; existing battles keep their archived executor until the existing explicit upgrade command is allowed and chosen. Do not patch archived bundles.
acceptance: Cryptographic outputs match exactly on all vectors.
No gameplay/RNG differences except the reviewed version boundary.
Native implementation measurably improves end_turn; separate current-run behavior from new-battle behavior.

steps: Design opt-in versioned frame-local references for duplicate leader and exact scene fields within a single response.
Keep canonical complete receipts and default legacy JSON for unnegotiated clients.
Use exact equality to remove a mirror, never guess equality from actor ID or entity name.
Reconstruct the complete current canonical DTO in the API adapter before existing UI consumers run.

Test full GET/reload, decisions, initialization opening state, solo and parties of 2/4/6, old responses, exact retry after another accepted command, corrupt/missing references, dropped connection and worker failure.
Measure actual uncompressed/gzip bytes, marshal/compression time and click-to-ready with the captured scene.
acceptance: Expanded response equals canonical legacy response.
No dependence on prior browser revision/cache.
Fewer repeated large fields and measured end-to-end improvement; no historical receipt rewrite.

steps: Trace which CharacterV3 fields each supported archived/current projection actually reads.
Negotiate a projection-input capability or preserve the complete input for executors without proved compatibility; remove only data which is provably overwritten/unused.
Decode and validate mirrors directly into the authoritative typed result, avoiding repeated whole-result marshal/unmarshal while retaining exact hash/size/schema checks.
Compare complete results and errors with legacy transport for archived artifacts and distinct catalogs/parties.
Profile allocation/GC, worker_request_bytes and mirror expansion separately.
acceptance: Malformed references fail closed before any write.
Full projected patches, runtime revisions, RNG and traces match.

steps: Inventory all DB-triggered fields, Save hooks, timestamps, access decorations and participant ordering currently provided by the final reload.
Construct a response from the saved locked aggregate only if it can match the canonical reload DTO.
Add comparisons against a real GET on the same committed revision for solo/party, conclusion, aura/rest effects and timestamps.
Exercise concurrent updates, exact historical retry and injected journal/receipt failures.
Measure eliminated reads and lock hold time; revert if any metadata or atomicity discrepancy remains.
acceptance: Canonical GET equality under defined timestamp representation.
No weaker CAS/locks or partial commits.
Measured reduction in SQL and transaction time.

steps: Profile repeated aura/light/nearby pair calculations per single authoritative transition.
Reuse derivations only for identical spatial and mechanical inputs inside that transition.
Explicitly invalidate for token changes, death/consciousness, plane/size, magic suppression, effect/source expiry, resources and relevant rules data.
Test two independent declarative aura/light entities plus movement, disappearance, unconsciousness and antimagic.
Compare complete output and RNG on the historical replay and synthetic party capacities; ship under a new artifact.
acceptance: Derived effects and availability remain identical.
No turn-only cache or name/UUID special cases.
Lower CPU on repeated AI turns without changing retained artifacts.

steps: Record code hashes and before/after evidence for the same revision-28 and short-action copies, including first request and at least 30 warm samples.
Run relevant authority/retry/rollback, transport compatibility and browser readiness suites.
Deploy only locally verified changes within user authorization using the project TimeWeb workflow; take the required current production backup and source identity.
Use opt-in numeric telemetry for controlled authorized requests, never replay mutating commands into a player's live battle.
Report ordinary-action and end_turn percentiles separately with byte counts and number of automatic AI turns.
acceptance: Ordinary warm action p95 target <=500ms assessed on TimeWeb; disclose any missed target.
No gameplay data loss or implicit rules upgrade.

userAcceptedLossBudget.boundaries: initialize, upgrade, outcomes and economy durable

steps: Review staged production diff and scanners.
Commit verified scope excluding private captures and personal skills.
Push exact main SHA; await required same-SHA CI, immutable image publication and guarded deployment.
Fresh host backup and saved previous production commit before cutover.
Independently compare actual identities/digests/health to accepted deployment receipt.
Benchmark only isolated owned copies; do not command the player combat.
Compare original TimeWeb 1931–3170 ms HTTP measurements with matched new scenarios.
Record cold/warm, prediction hit/miss, previous persistence wait, p50/p95/max and sample count.
Do not claim a universal 200 ms maximum from a warm subset; continue optimization if the budget is exceeded.
